title: Glowing mobile phone
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- phone body -->
  <rect x='30' y='12' width='40' height='76' rx='8' fill='#3a4a8a'/>
  <!-- body highlight edge -->
  <rect x='33' y='16' width='34' height='66' rx='5' fill='#4a5cb0'/>
  <!-- screen border -->
  <rect x='36' y='20' width='28' height='54' rx='3' fill='#1a2050'/>
  <!-- glowing screen -->
  <rect x='38' y='23' width='24' height='48' rx='2' fill='#7ff0ff'/>
  <!-- screen glow inner -->
  <rect x='41' y='26' width='18' height='42' rx='1' fill='#c8ffff'/>
  <!-- app icons on screen -->
  <rect x='43' y='30' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ff8ad0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='30' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ffd35c'/>
  <rect x='43' y='39' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#8affa0'/>
  <rect x='51' y='39' width='6' height='6' rx='1.5' fill='#ff9c5c'/>
  <rect x='43' y='48' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a0b8ff'/>
  <rect x='43' y='55' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#a0b8ff'/>
  <!-- home button -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='82' r='3' fill='#7a8ada'/>
  <!-- glow rays -->
  <path d='M18 22 L24 30 M16 50 L24 50 M18 78 L24 70' stroke='#9df5ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
  <path d='M82 22 L76 30 M84 50 L76 50 M82 78 L76 70' stroke='#9df5ff' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round' fill='none'/>
</svg>
